gradient_data_split: train only, SHA order, no label selection
scope: Source-train gradients, source-validation calibration/AP and fixed100development AP/FPR only. No new training, validation/locked arrays remain closed. No VUS rescan until mechanism evidence warrants it.
identity: S=B+a+mean(r)+KL(U||softmax(r)); a confident root distribution adds a nonnegative term even without evidence that an anomaly exists
falsification: If source task gradients are not conflicting or KL-removal is no better than constant/shuffled subtraction, do not attribute the detection loss to that mechanism. A failed frozen edit does not reject a separately trained decoupled architecture.
limits: Gradient dot products describe local training geometry, not proof of target failure cause. Counterfactual readout arithmetic is an ablation, not an identified physical intervention or trained final solution.
